title: Gobinator
tagline: Double-click a Jedi Knight episode and play it
description:
Gobinator is a small Windows launcher for Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II. Make .gob files open with it, and a double-click on any episode, wherever you downloaded it, copies it into your game's Episode folder, puts it at the top of the game's episode list and starts Jedi Knight. On OpenJKDF2, and on Jedi Knight Remastered 3.3, which runs on it, you land straight in the episode's first level.

The game lists at most 64 episodes, so in a big collection the rest never appear; the one you double-click is always first, however many you have. Your own mods in the mod folder still load on top, and Gobinator never deletes or overwrites a GOB. Start Gobinator by itself and the game's usual list comes back.

It works with the Steam, GOG and CD releases of Jedi Knight, with Jedi Knight Remastered and with OpenJKDF2. It does not handle Mysteries of the Sith.
features: Double-click any Jedi Knight episode GOB, wherever it is, and the game starts with it
The episode you pick tops the episode list, past the game's 64-episode limit
On OpenJKDF2 and JK Remastered 3.3 you land straight in the episode's first level
Never deletes or overwrites a GOB: your own episodes stay safe
Your mods in the mod folder still load on top of the episode
Works with the Steam, GOG and CD releases, JK Remastered and OpenJKDF2
Start it by itself to get the game's usual episode list back
Says what went wrong in plain words, and handles accented and Japanese file names

play.requirements: Windows 10 or 11, and Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: the Steam, GOG or CD release, Jedi Knight Remastered, or OpenJKDF2

notice: Gobinator is a fan-made tool for Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II, not made or endorsed by LucasArts, Lucasfilm or Disney, and it does not include the game. Star Wars, Jedi Knight and their art belong to Lucasfilm; the game's own menus appear in the screenshots.
ai: The logo, the icon and the key art were made with AI (Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro). Much of Gobinator 1.1's code was written with AI (Claude); version 1.0 was written by hand in 2022. The Crab Factory, the episode in the screenshots, was generated by COG Factory's tools, which are written with AI.
